roughness.source: Workings/honed.json: surface.glossGround (under 5 GU at 60 degrees) and unverified surface.glossAtFinalGrit
roughness.note: A matte face with no reflected image; no conversion from gloss units to a slope distribution was read.

roughnessAcross.source: Workings/honed.json: a honed face has no grain

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.source: Workings/honed.json: surface.arealRoughness (Sa 0.22 mm, measured; it includes pores and waviness)
textureDepth.derivation: the areal roughness taken as the mean texture depth the face holds as a film
